content: संग्रह् €9 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To collect, gather, accumulate, hoard; संगृह्य धनम्, पाशान् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To receive kindly. .²3 To curb, restrain, check, control, rein in (as horses). .²4 To unstring (as a bow). .²5 To grasp, lay hold of. .²6 To take, receive, accept. .²7 To conceive, understand. .²8 To contract, abridge, narrow. .²9 To encourage, support, favour. .²10 To seize upon, attack (as an illness). .²11 To include, comprise, contain. .²12 To close, shut (as the mouth). .²13 To concentrate. .²14 To constrain, force; तैस्तैरुपायैः संगृह्य दापयेदधमर्णिकम् <ls>Ms. 8. 48</ls>. .²15 To marry. .²16 To mention, name.
